facts.summary: Interim immunogenicity below expectations, comparable to or below convalescent sera · Phase 1/2 · IVX-411 in COVID-19 · not yet approved

evidence.summary: while IVX-411 was immunogenic and well-tolerated in these initial topline data, the level of response was below the Company’s expectations given what it knows about VLPs
evidence.safety: There were no serious AEs deemed to be related to vaccine, AEs of special interest, or AEs leading to discontinuation.
